| 12    | UnknownReason     | Unknown or unspeci<br>fied reason                                                     | M           |

#### <span id="page-879-0"></span>**11.4.6.3. ICEServerStruct Type**

This type SHALL specify the [RFC 8825](#page-30-5) compliant [ICE servers](#page-30-12) used to facilitate the negotiation of peer-to-peer connections through NATs (Network Address Translators) and firewalls. It mimics the model used in the W3C WebRTC API [RTCIceServer](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver) [https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver] dictionary with the addition of a Matter specific field for specifying the Root Certificate of any ICE servers that require TLS.

There are two types of ICE Servers which help to discover the public IP address of a device and relay media traffic when direct peer-to-peer communication is not possible:

- [STUN](#page-30-10) Servers, which help to discover the public IP address and NAT/Firewall type if any, of a device. When a WebRTC session starts, it contacts the STUN server, which returns the device's public IP and port number. This information is used to generate ICE candidates for the peer-topeer connection setup.
- [TURN](#page-30-11) Servers, which are used when STUN is not sufficient to establish a peer-to-peer connection—typically such as when devices are behind symmetric NATs, which STUN cannot traverse. TURN servers act as a relay between the peers, routing the media traffic between them.

| ID | Name       | Type         | Constraint           | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|------------|--------------|----------------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | URLs       | list[string] | max 10<br>[max 2000] |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | Username   | string       | max 508              |         |          |        | O               |
| 2  | Credential | string       | max 512              |         |          |        | O               |
| 3  | CAID       | TLSCAID      | 0 to 65534           |         |          |        | O               |

#### <span id="page-880-0"></span>**11.4.6.3.1. URLs Field**

This field SHALL specify a list of URLs pointing to the STUN and/or TURN servers. The URL scheme distinguishes whether it is a STUN or TURN server (stun:, stuns:, turn:, or turns: respectively). This field maps to the [RTCIceServer urls](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver-urls) [https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver-urls] field.

#### **11.4.6.3.2. Username Field**

(Optional for STUN, usually required for TURN) The [RFC 8489](#page-30-10) compliant UTF-8 encoded username required for authentication with the STUN or TURN servers found in the URLs field. This field maps to the [RTCIceServer username](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver-username) [https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver-username] field.

#### **11.4.6.3.3. Credential Field**

(Optional for STUN, usually required for TURN) The [RFC 8489](#page-30-10) compliant UTF-8 encoded short-term credential (password) used for authentication with the STUN or TURN servers found in the URLs field. This field maps to the [RTCIceServer credential](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver-credential) [https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtciceserver-credential] field.

#### **11.4.6.3.4. CAID Field**

This field represents the TLSRCAC via its assigned TLSCAID (see Chapter 14, Certificate Authority ID (CAID) Mapping and TLS Certificate Management Commands sections in [\[MatterCore\]\)](#page-28-5) that will validate the certificate chain presented by the entries in the urls field. It SHALL be set to a valid value if a turns: or stuns: url is present in the urls field and SHALL be used to validate those servers' presented TLS root certificates.

# <span id="page-880-1"></span>**11.4.6.4. ICECandidateStruct Type**

This type SHALL specify the [RFC 8825](#page-30-5) compliant [ICE Candidate](#page-30-12) used to facilitate the negotiation of peer-to-peer connections through NATs (Network Address Translators) and firewalls. It mimics the model used in the W3C WebRTC API [RTCIceCandidate](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#rtcicecandidate-interface) [https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#rtcicecandidateinterface] dictionary.

| ID | Name      | Type   | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-----------|--------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | Candidate | string |            |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | SDPMid    | string | min 1      | X       |          |        | M               |

| ID | Name              | Type   | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-------------------|--------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 2  | SDPM<br>LineIndex | uint16 |            | X       |          |        | M               |

#### **11.4.6.4.1. Candidate Field**

This field SHALL specify the [RFC 8825](#page-30-5) compliant [RFC 8839](#page-30-12) candidate-attribute field in string form. This is the same value as the W3C WebRTC API RTCIceCandidate [candidate](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtcicecandidate-candidate) [https://www.w3.org/TR/ webrtc/#dom-rtcicecandidate-candidate] value. The RFCs define no min or max length on this value.

**Note:** This string is not the same string as doing a candidate.toString() on a RTCIceCandidate ECMAScript object itself. Some browsers and ECMAScript libraries use non-standard ways to serialize sdpMid and sdpMLineIndex into the resulting string, but this is not defined in the W3 specification. This specification requires those fields to be passed directly using the named struct fields [SDP-](#page-881-1)[Mid](#page-881-1) and [SDPMLineIndex](#page-881-2).

#### <span id="page-881-1"></span>**11.4.6.4.2. SDPMid Field**

This field SHALL specify the Candidate's media stream identification tag which uniquely identifies the media stream within the component with which the candidate is associated, or null if no such association exists. This is the same value as the W3C WebRTC API RTCIceCandidate [sdpMid](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtcicecandidate-sdpmid) [https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtcicecandidate-sdpmid] value. The RFCs define no max length on this value.

#### <span id="page-881-2"></span>**11.4.6.4.3. SDPMLineIndex Field**

This field SHALL specify the zero-based index number of the media description (as defined in [RFC 8866](#page-30-9)) in the SDP with which the Candidate is associated or null if no such association exists. This is the same value as the W3C WebRTC API RTCIceCandidate [sdpMLineIndex](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#dom-rtcicecandidate-sdpmlineindex) [https://www.w3.org/ TR/webrtc/#dom-rtcicecandidate-sdpmlineindex] value.

#### <span id="page-881-0"></span>**11.4.6.5. WebRTCSessionStruct Type**

This type stores all the relevant values associated with an active WebRTC session.

| Access Modifier: Fabric Scoped |                    |                     |            |         |          |        |                 |
|--------------------------------|--------------------|---------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| ID                             | Name               | Type                | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
| 0                              | ID                 | WebRTC<br>SessionID | all        |         |          |        | M               |
| 1                              | PeerN<br>odeID     | node-id             | all        |         |          |        | M               |
| 2                              | PeerEnd<br>pointID | endpoint<br>no      | all        |         |          |        | M               |

| Access Modifier: Fabric Scoped |                         |                         |         |   |  |  |      |
|--------------------------------|-------------------------|-------------------------|---------|---|--|--|------|
| 3                              | Strea<br>mUsage         | Strea<br>mUsageEn<br>um | all     |   |  |  | M    |
| 4                              | VideoStre<br>amID       | VideoStrea<br>mID       | all     | X |  |  | O, D |
| 5                              | AudioStre<br>amID       | AudioStrea<br>mID       | all     | X |  |  | O, D |
| 6                              | Meta<br>dataEn<br>abled | bool                    | all     |   |  |  | M    |
| 7                              | VideoStre<br>ams        | list[VideoSt<br>reamID] | 1 to 16 |   |  |  | O.a+ |
| 8                              | AudioStre<br>ams        | list[AudioS<br>treamID] | 1 to 16 |   |  |  | O.a+ |

This values of PeerNodeID and FabricIndex are used to validate the source of, or select the correct remote target, for WebRTC session related commands. The implicit field FabricIndex exists since this structure is defined as Fabric Scoped.

#### **11.4.6.5.1. ID Field**

This field contains the WebRTC Session ID for this session.

# <span id="page-882-1"></span>**11.4.6.5.2. PeerNodeID Field**

This field contains the NodeId for the peer entity involved in this session.

# <span id="page-882-0"></span>**11.4.6.5.3. PeerEndpointID Field**

This field contains the EndpointId for the peer entity involved in this session.

## **11.4.6.5.4. StreamUsage Field**

This field contains the [StreamUsageEnum](#page-816-5) of this session.

### **11.4.6.5.5. VideoStreamID Field**

This field is deprecated and the [VideoStreams](#page-883-4) field used instead.

For compatibility with clients implementing cluster revision 1, the first video stream found in the [VideoStreams](#page-883-4) field SHALL be populated here, or null if no video stream is currently associated with this session.

### **11.4.6.5.6. AudioStreamID Field**

This field is deprecated and the [AudioStreams](#page-883-3) field used instead.

For compatibility with clients implementing cluster revision 1, the first audio stream found in the [AudioStreams](#page-883-3) field SHALL be populated here, or null if no audio stream is currently associated with this session.

#### **11.4.6.5.7. MetadataEnabled Field**

This field indicates if [metadata](#page-884-3) is active in this session.

#### <span id="page-883-4"></span>**11.4.6.5.8. VideoStreams Field**

This field SHALL be a list of all video streams used by this session. Each [VideoStreamID](#page-833-0) entry corresponds to an entry in the [AllocatedVideoStreams](#page-839-3) attribute.

- If present, the specified video streams from the [AllocatedVideoStreams](#page-839-3) attribute SHALL be used.
- If not present, this session has no video.

#### <span id="page-883-3"></span>**11.4.6.5.9. AudioStreams Field**

This field SHALL be a list of all audio streams used by this session. Each [VideoStreamID](#page-833-0) entry corresponds to an entry in the [AllocatedVideoStreams](#page-839-3) attribute.

- If present, the specified audio streams from the [AllocatedAudioStreams](#page-839-2) attribute SHALL be used.
- If not present, this session has no audio.

# <span id="page-883-0"></span>**11.5. WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster**

The WebRTC transport provider cluster provides a way for stream providers (e.g. Cameras) to stream or receive their data through WebRTC. Devices implementing this cluster SHALL also implement [Camera AV Stream Management Cluster](#page-818-0) on the same endpoint.

# <span id="page-883-1"></span>**11.5.1. Revision History**

The global ClusterRevision attribute value SHALL be the highest revision number in the table below.

| Revision | Description                                                 |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1        | Initial version of the WebRTC Transport<br>Provider Cluster |
| 2        | Add multi stream support                                    |

# <span id="page-883-2"></span>**11.5.2. Classification**

| Hierarchy | Role        | Scope    | PICS Code |
|-----------|-------------|----------|-----------|
| Base      | Application | Endpoint | WEBRTCP   |

# <span id="page-884-0"></span>**11.5.3. Cluster ID**

| ID     | Name                      |
|--------|---------------------------|
| 0x0553 | WebRTC Transport Provider |

# <span id="page-884-1"></span>**11.5.4. Features**

This cluster SHALL support the FeatureMap bitmap attribute as defined below.

| Bit | Code     | Feature  | Conformance | Summary                                                 |
|-----|----------|----------|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| 0   | METADATA | Metadata | P, O        | Supports metadata<br>transmission in<br>WebRTC sessions |

# <span id="page-884-3"></span>**11.5.4.1. Metadata Feature**

When this feature is supported and a session activates it, a WebRTC DataChannel using the protocol name urn:csa:matter:av-metadata SHALL be used for transmitting the metadata. The ability to include metadata is supported on a per session basis.

This feature is designed to be [JSEP](#page-30-15) compliant with the [RTCDataChannel](https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/#rtcdatachannel) [https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/# rtcdatachannel] object interface and consists of [AVMetadataStruct](#page-832-0) content.

If [SFrame End-to-End Encryption](#page-877-0) is active in a session, all metadata transmissions SHALL be sent using the protocol name urn:csa:matter:sframe:av-metadata instead with each transmission being wrapped in SFrames.

# <span id="page-884-2"></span>**11.5.5. Data Types**

#### <span id="page-884-4"></span>**11.5.5.1. SFrameStruct Type**

This type SHALL specify the [RFC 9605](#page-30-14) data needed to use [SFrames](#page-877-0) as an end-to-end encryption mechanism with WebRTC.

| ID | Name            | Type   | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-----------------|--------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | Cipher<br>Suite | uint16 | min 1      |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | BaseKey         | octstr | max 128    |         |          |        | M               |
| 2  | KID             | octstr | 2 to 8     |         |          |        | M               |

# <span id="page-884-5"></span>**11.5.5.1.1. CipherSuite Field**

This field SHALL specify the SFrame cipher suite value as defined in [RFC 9605](#page-30-14) Section 8.1 Cipher Suites table, and maintained in the IANA [SFrame Registry](https://www.iana.org/assignments/sframe/sframe.xhtml) [https://www.iana.org/assignments/sframe/ sframe.xhtml].

#### <span id="page-885-4"></span>**11.5.5.1.2. BaseKey Field**

This field SHALL specify the SFrame base\_key value to use for a session. The length of this key depends on the selected cipher suite's Nk value as defined in [Section 4.5 Cipher Suites](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9605.html#name-cipher-suites) [https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9605.html#name-cipher-suites].

#### **11.5.5.1.3. KID Field**

This field SHALL specify the initial SFrame KID (Key Id) value to be used. The bottom 8 bits of this value will be overwritten and used for ratchet step tracking.

|--------|---------|------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0x0000 | Cur     | list[WebRT | all        |         |          | R M S  | M               |

# <span id="page-885-2"></span>**11.5.6.1. CurrentSessions Attribute**

This attribute SHALL be a list of [WebRTCSessionStruct,](#page-881-0) which represents all the active WebRTC Sessions.

| ID   | Name                     | Direction          | Response                 | Access | Quality | Confor<br>mance |
|------|--------------------------|--------------------|--------------------------|--------|---------|-----------------|
| 0x00 | SolicitOffer             | client ⇒<br>server | SolicitOffer<br>Response | O F    | L       | M               |
| 0x01 | SolicitOffer<br>Response | client ⇐<br>server | N                        |        | L       | M               |

| 0x03 | ProvideOf<br>ferResponse | client ⇐<br>server | N                        |        | L       | M               |
