# <span id="page-918-0"></span>**11.7.3. Revision History**

The global ClusterRevision attribute value SHALL be the highest revision number in the table below.

| Revision | Description                                                                                                                                               |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1        | Initial Release                                                                                                                                           |
| 2        | Add DoorbellPressed to TriggerActivationRea<br>son. Augment PushTransport events with Ses<br>sion numbers and Event context. Add multi<br>stream support. |

# <span id="page-919-0"></span>**11.7.4. Classification**

| Hierarchy | Role        | Scope    | PICS Code |
|-----------|-------------|----------|-----------|
| Base      | Application | Endpoint | PAVST     |

# <span id="page-919-1"></span>**11.7.5. Cluster ID**

| ID     | Name                     |
|--------|--------------------------|
| 0x0555 | Push AV Stream Transport |

# <span id="page-919-2"></span>**11.7.6. Features**

This cluster SHALL support the FeatureMap bitmap attribute as defined below.

| Bit | Code        | Feature              | Conformance | Summary                                                 |
|-----|-------------|----------------------|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| 0   | PERZONESENS | PerZoneSensitivity O |             | Supports a sensi<br>tivity value per<br>Zone            |
| 1   | METADATA    | Metadata             | P, O        | Supports metadata<br>transmission in<br>Push transports |

## <span id="page-919-5"></span>**11.7.6.1. PerZoneSensitivity Feature**

When this feature is supported, the [Sensitivity](#page-926-0) for a Motion Trigger can be set per zone. When not supported, only a single [sensitivity](#page-927-0) can be used for all Motion Triggers.

#### **11.7.6.2. Metadata Feature**

When this feature is supported and a transport activates it, metadata SHALL be included within the uploaded data.

# <span id="page-919-3"></span>**11.7.7. Data Types**

### <span id="page-919-4"></span>**11.7.7.1. TransportTriggerTypeEnum Type**

This data type is derived from enum8.

The Trigger Type determines the basic operation of the Push Transport and when it will actually transmit content.

| Value | Name    | Summary                                      | Conformance |
|-------|---------|----------------------------------------------|-------------|
| 0     | Command | Triggered only via a<br>command invocation   | M           |
| 1     | Motion  | Triggered via motion<br>detection or command | M           |

| Value | Name       | Summary                                                | Conformance |
|-------|------------|--------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| 2     | Continuous | Triggered always when<br>transport status is<br>Active | M           |

### <span id="page-920-5"></span>**11.7.7.1.1. Command Value**

When set to this value, transport will only occur if a command is invoked to trigger it. This could be a [ManuallyTriggerTransport](#page-942-1) command or an internally triggered command such as a physical button press.

#### <span id="page-920-4"></span>**11.7.7.1.2. Motion Value**

When set to this value, transport will occur if either the Motion Detector becomes triggered, or [ManuallyTriggerTransport](#page-942-1) is invoked. This is generally known as event driven recording.

### <span id="page-920-3"></span>**11.7.7.1.3. Continuous Value**

When set to this value, transport will always occur so long as the [TransportStatus](#page-920-6) is Active. This is generally known as 24/7 always-on recording.

# <span id="page-920-6"></span>**11.7.7.2. TransportStatusEnum Type**

This data type is derived from enum8.

| Value | Name     | Summary                                       | Conformance |
|-------|----------|-----------------------------------------------|-------------|
| 0     | Active   | Push Transport can<br>transport AV Streams    | M           |
| 1     | Inactive | Push Transport cannot<br>transport AV Streams | M           |

#### <span id="page-920-2"></span>**11.7.7.3. ContainerFormatEnum Type**

This data type is derived from enum8.

| Value | Name | Summary               | Conformance |
|-------|------|-----------------------|-------------|
| 0     | CMAF | CMAF container format | M           |

# <span id="page-920-1"></span>**11.7.7.3.1. CMAF Value**

CMAF (Common Media Application Format) is a container format based on the [ISO Base Media File](#page-29-13) [Format](#page-29-13) and is described in [MPEGCMAF](#page-29-14). Nodes using CMAF as the container format SHALL also use CMAFIngest as the ingestion format.

#### <span id="page-920-0"></span>**11.7.7.4. IngestMethodsEnum Type**

| Value | Name       | Summary               | Conformance |
|-------|------------|-----------------------|-------------|
| 0     | CMAFIngest | CMAF ingestion format | M           |

### <span id="page-921-0"></span>**11.7.7.4.1. CMAFIngest Value**

This value SHALL mean that CMAF Ingestion is utilized. See [CMAF Ingestion](#page-904-0) for full details.

## <span id="page-921-2"></span>**11.7.7.5. TriggerActivationReasonEnum Type**

This data type is derived from enum8.

| Value | Name            | Summary                                                 | Conformance |
|-------|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| 0     | UserInitiated   | Trigger has been acti<br>vated by user action           | M           |
| 1     | Automation      | Trigger has been acti<br>vated by automation            | M           |
| 2     | Emergency       | Trigger has been acti<br>vated for emergency<br>reasons | M           |
| 3     | DoorbellPressed | Trigger has been acti<br>vated by a doorbell<br>press   | Rev >= v2   |

### <span id="page-921-1"></span>**11.7.7.6. SupportedFormatStruct Type**

This struct holds the combination of container format and ingest method which represents a valid combination for a transport.

| ID | Name                | Type                        | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------------------|-----------------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | Container<br>Format | Container<br>For<br>matEnum | all        |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | Ingest<br>Method    | Ingest<br>Method<br>sEnum   | all        |         |          |        | M               |

#### **11.7.7.6.1. ContainerFormat Field**

This field SHALL indicate a supported [container format](#page-920-2) that when combined with IngestMethod, can be used in a transport.

#### **11.7.7.6.2. IngestMethod Field**

This field SHALL indicate a supported [ingest method](#page-920-0) that when combined with ContainerFormat, can be used in a transport.

## <span id="page-922-4"></span>**11.7.7.7. CMAFInterfaceEnum Type**

This data type is derived from enum8. This type indicates the exact mode of CMAF that is in use.

| Value | Name           | Summary                                    | Conformance |
|-------|----------------|--------------------------------------------|-------------|
| 0     | Interface1     | CMAF Interface-1 Mode                      | M           |
| 1     | Interface2DASH | CMAF Interface-2 Mode<br>with DASH Support | P, M        |
| 2     | Interface2HLS  | CMAF Interface-2 Mode<br>with HLS Support  | P, M        |

### <span id="page-922-3"></span>**11.7.7.7.1. Interface1 Value**

This value indicates that only the operations specified in [CMAF Interface-1](https://dashif.org/Ingest/#interface-1) [https://dashif.org/Ingest/# interface-1] will be done.

#### <span id="page-922-1"></span>**11.7.7.7.2. Interface2DASH Value**

This value indicates the operations specified in [CMAF Interface-2](https://dashif.org/Ingest/#interface-2) [https://dashif.org/Ingest/#interface-2] with the [DASH specific portions](https://dashif.org/Ingest/#dash-ingest-requirements) [https://dashif.org/Ingest/#dash-ingest-requirements] will be done.

#### <span id="page-922-2"></span>**11.7.7.7.3. Interface2HLS Value**

This value indicates the operations specified in [CMAF Interface-2](https://dashif.org/Ingest/#interface-2) [https://dashif.org/Ingest/#interface-2] with the [HLS specific portions](https://dashif.org/Ingest/#hls-ingest-requirements) [https://dashif.org/Ingest/#hls-ingest-requirements] will be done.

#### <span id="page-922-5"></span>**11.7.7.8. VideoStreamStruct Type**

This struct holds a video stream id and the symbolic stream name associated with it. For [CMAF](#page-920-1) based transports, this becomes a [CMAF Track.](#page-905-0)

| ID | Name                | Type              | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------------------|-------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | VideoStre<br>amName | string            | 1 to 16    |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | VideoStre<br>amID   | VideoStrea<br>mID | all        |         |          |        | M               |

# <span id="page-922-0"></span>**11.7.7.8.1. VideoStreamName Field**

This field SHALL identify the unique name assigned to this stream. In CMAF, this value becomes the [CMAF track name](#page-906-2).

#### <span id="page-922-6"></span>**11.7.7.8.2. VideoStreamID Field**

This field SHALL indicate the video stream identified by the [VideoStreamID](#page-833-0) entry in the [Allocated-](#page-839-3)[VideoStreams](#page-839-3) list to use.

### <span id="page-923-2"></span>**11.7.7.9. AudioStreamStruct Type**

This struct holds a video stream id and the symbolic stream name associated with it. For [CMAF](#page-920-1) based transports, this becomes a [CMAF Track](#page-905-0).

| ID | Name                | Type              | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------------------|-------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | AudioStre<br>amName | string            | 1 to 16    |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | AudioStre<br>amID   | AudioStrea<br>mID | all        |         |          |        | M               |

#### <span id="page-923-1"></span>**11.7.7.9.1. AudioStreamName Field**

This field SHALL identify the unique name assigned to this stream. In CMAF, this value becomes the [CMAF track name.](#page-906-2)

#### <span id="page-923-3"></span>**11.7.7.9.2. AudioStreamID Field**

This field SHALL indicate the audio stream identified by the [AudioStreamID](#page-833-1) entry in the [Allo](#page-839-2)[catedAudioStreams](#page-839-2) list to use.

### <span id="page-923-0"></span>**11.7.7.10. CMAFContainerOptionsStruct Type**

This struct encodes options for configuration of the CMAF container format.

| ID | Name                | Type                      | Constraint                       | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------------------|---------------------------|----------------------------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | CMAFIn<br>terface   | CMAFIn<br>ter<br>faceEnum | all                              |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | Segment<br>Duration | uint16                    | 500 to<br>65500                  |         |          |        | M               |
| 2  | ChunkDu<br>ration   | uint16                    | 0 to (Seg<br>mentDura<br>tion/2) |         |          |        | M               |
| 3  | Session<br>Group    | uint8                     | all                              |         |          |        | O, D            |
| 4  | Track<br>Name       | string                    | 1 to 16                          |         |          |        | O, D            |
| 5  | CENCKey             | octstr                    | 16                               |         |          |        | P, O            |
| 6  | CENCK<br>eyID       | octstr                    | 16                               |         |          |        | P, CENCKey      |

| ID | Name                    | Type | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-------------------------|------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 7  | Meta<br>dataEn<br>abled | bool | all        |         |          |        | [META<br>DATA]  |

#### **11.7.7.10.1. CMAFInterface Field**

This field SHALL indicate the selected Interface of the CMAF container. The Interface chosen determines the number and type of operations that occur within each CMAF session. See [CMAFInter](#page-922-4)[faceEnum](#page-922-4) for details on CMAF Interfaces.

#### <span id="page-924-0"></span>**11.7.7.10.2. SegmentDuration Field**

This field SHALL indicate the segment duration (in milliseconds) of the CMAF container. This value SHALL be a multiple of the [KeyFrameInterval](#page-829-1) for the associated video stream. It is RECOMMENDED to use a value of 4000 (4 seconds).

#### **11.7.7.10.3. ChunkDuration Field**

This field SHALL indicate the chunk duration (in milliseconds) of the CMAF container. A value of 0 SHALL indicate that chunks are not used.

When chunking is used, an even divisor of SegmentDuration SHOULD be used that aligns with the video frame rate and audio frame duration. RECOMMENDED values are 1/2, 1/4, or 1/8 of the SegmentDuration depending on the end to end latency requirements needed. Each chunk results in an additional 144 bytes of overhead in the resulting file.

#### **11.7.7.10.4. SessionGroup Field**

This field is deprecated and has been replaced with the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) and [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) fields.

#### **11.7.7.10.5. TrackName Field**

This field is deprecated and has been replaced with the [VideoStreamName](#page-922-0) or [AudioStreamName](#page-923-1) fields of the associated stream entry in the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) or [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) lists

#### **11.7.7.10.6. CENCKey Field**

This field, if present, SHALL indicate the [CENC](#page-29-12) key to be used to encrypt the CMAF data. When absent, the CMAF data SHALL be sent without CENC encryption added. See [CMAF Background](#page-904-2) for further details on CMAF CENC encryption.

### **11.7.7.10.7. CENCKeyID Field**

This field, if present, SHALL indicate the opaque [CENC](#page-29-12) Key ID (KID) that represents the key in the Controllers ecosystem. This fields maps to the KID value as specified in ISO 23001-7:2023 or later. See [CMAF Background](#page-904-2) for further details on CMAF CENC encryption.

#### **11.7.7.10.8. MetadataEnabled Field**

This field, if present and true, indicates that [AVMetadataStruct](#page-832-0) based Metadata tracks and boxes MAY be included in the CMAF segments. If this field is not present or is false, metadata tracks and boxes SHALL NOT be included.

Metadata within CMAF segments when used, SHALL be encoded as follows:

- Use urim as the codec-type.
- Use meta as the content-type.
- Use urn:csa:matter:av-metadata as the uri.

Placement of the metadata SHALL be as follows:

- Use a single trac for time-synced data points as described in [CMAF-Ingest](#page-29-10) Interface-1 Section 6.6 [Requirements for Timed Metadata Tracks](https://dashif.org/Ingest/#interface-1-timed-metadata) [https://dashif.org/Ingest/#interface-1-timed-metadata].
- Use a single Box for non-time synced data points.

### <span id="page-925-1"></span>**11.7.7.11. ContainerOptionsStruct Type**

This struct encodes the specific container type options struct

| ID | Name                         | Type                               | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance              |
|----|------------------------------|------------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|------------------------------|
| 0  | Container<br>Type            | Container<br>For<br>matEnum        | all        |         |          |        | M                            |
| 1  | CMAFCon<br>tainerOp<br>tions | CMAFCon<br>tainerOp<br>tionsStruct |            |         |          |        | Container<br>Type ==<br>CMAF |

#### <span id="page-925-2"></span>**11.7.7.11.1. ContainerType Field**

This field SHALL indicate the container type chosen for this transport.

#### **11.7.7.11.2. CMAFContainerOptions Field**

This field SHALL contain a [CMAF Container Options](#page-923-0) if the ContainerType is set to CMAF, otherwise this field SHALL be omitted.

#### <span id="page-925-0"></span>**11.7.7.12. TransportZoneOptionsStruct Type**

This struct encodes the options that configure the per [Zone](#page-254-0) portion of a Trigger configuration.

| ID | Name | Type   | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|------|--------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | Zone | ZoneID | all        | X       |          |        | M               |

| ID | Name        | Type  | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-------------|-------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 1  | Sensitivity | uint8 | 1 to 10    |         |          |        | PERZONE<br>SENS |

#### <span id="page-926-2"></span>**11.7.7.12.1. Zone Field**

This field SHALL be a [Motion](#page-256-5) [ZoneID](#page-261-1) found in the [Zone Management Cluster](#page-254-0) which SHALL cause the trigger to activate. If not null, motion in this zone will activate the trigger. If null, motion anywhere in the complement of the union of all the [Zones](#page-262-2) defined in the [Zone Management Cluster](#page-254-0) on this endpoint will activate the trigger.

#### <span id="page-926-0"></span>**11.7.7.12.2. Sensitivity Field**

This field SHALL indicate how sensitive the trigger for the specified Zone is, and SHALL match the same implementation specifics as the [Sensitivity](#page-262-0) attribute in the [Zone Management Cluster.](#page-254-0) This field SHALL only be included when [PerZoneSensitivity](#page-919-5) is supported, otherwise the value from [MotionSensitivity](#page-927-0) is used.

### <span id="page-926-1"></span>**11.7.7.13. TransportTriggerOptionsStruct Type**

This struct encodes the conditions and options that configures the trigger for the push transport. The transport SHALL only start transmitting AV Streams when it's associated trigger is activated.

| ID | Name                      | Type                                                    | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance                                    |
|----|---------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|
| 0  | Trigger<br>Type           | Transport<br>Trigger<br>TypeEnum                        | all        |         |          |        | M                                                  |
| 1  | Motion<br>Zones           | list[Trans<br>portZo<br>neOption<br>sStruct]            |            | X       |          |        | Trigger<br>Type ==<br>Motion                       |
| 2  | Motion<br>Sensitivity     | uint8                                                   | 1 to 10    | X       |          |        | Trigger<br>Type ==<br>Motion &<br>!PERZONE<br>SENS |
| 3  | Motion<br>TimeCon<br>trol | Transport<br>Motion<br>Trigger<br>TimeCon<br>trolStruct |            |         |          |        | Trigger<br>Type ==<br>Motion                       |

| ID | Name              | Type   | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance                                                 |
|----|-------------------|--------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
| 4  | MaxPre<br>RollLen | uint16 | all        |         |          |        | Trigger<br>Type ==<br>Command<br>  Trigger<br>Type ==<br>Motion |

#### <span id="page-927-1"></span>**11.7.7.13.1. TriggerType Field**

This field SHALL indicate the type of the transport trigger.

#### <span id="page-927-2"></span>**11.7.7.13.2. MotionZones Field**

This field SHALL be a list of [TransportZoneOptionsStruct](#page-925-0) containing the [Motion](#page-256-5) Zones to trigger on. If this list is null, empty, or the [Zone Management Cluster](#page-254-0) is not supported on this endpoint, then motion anywhere SHALL cause the trigger to activate. The maximum size of this list is [MaxZones.](#page-262-4)

#### <span id="page-927-0"></span>**11.7.7.13.3. MotionSensitivity Field**

This field SHALL indicate how sensitive the trigger is to motion and SHALL match the same implementation specifics as [Sensitivity.](#page-262-0) This field SHALL NOT be used if the [PerZoneSensitivity](#page-255-4) feature is supported, as a Zone specific value is available in the [TransportZoneOptionsStruct](#page-925-0) [Sensitivity](#page-926-0) field. If this is null and the [Zone Management Cluster](#page-254-0) is supported on this endpoint, then the value found in the [Sensitivity](#page-262-0) attribute in the [Zone Management Cluster](#page-254-0) SHALL be used. If this is null and the [Zone Management Cluster](#page-254-0) is not supported on this endpoint, a value of 10 SHALL be used.

### <span id="page-927-4"></span>**11.7.7.13.4. MotionTimeControl Field**

This field SHALL control timing around repeated activation of the trigger (see [TransportMotion-](#page-928-0)[TriggerTimeControlStruct](#page-928-0)). If [TriggerType](#page-927-1) is [Motion Value,](#page-920-4) this field SHALL be required.

#### <span id="page-927-3"></span>**11.7.7.13.5. MaxPreRollLen Field**

This field SHALL indicate the maximum duration in milliseconds of pre-roll content that can be included, if the [TriggerType](#page-927-1) is [Motion Value](#page-920-4) or [Command Value](#page-920-5), when the trigger activates.

A value of 0 SHALL indicate that no extra segments beyond the one containing the trigger point will be sent.

When using a non 0 value, the value SHALL be greater than or equal to the value of the stream's [KeyFrameInterval](#page-829-1) and it SHOULD be a multiple of that value if larger.

The actual amount transmitted will always be less than or equal to the per stream storage amount found in the [MaxContentBufferSize](#page-838-2).

Since a transmission caused by a trigger activation always begins on the Container Format's segment (or [key-frame](#page-829-1)) boundary, if the trigger occurs mid segment, the entire segment still needs to be sent. This time delta between the actual trigger point and the start of the segment is counted as part of the pre-roll length. Thus, for more than the current segment to be sent as pre-roll, the full size of a segment must fit within the remainder of this length. For this reason, it is RECOMMENDED that a value of at least two times [SegmentDuration](#page-924-0) be used so that a full segment is always included if available.

# <span id="page-928-0"></span>**11.7.7.14. TransportMotionTriggerTimeControlStruct Type**

This struct is used to encode a set of values for controlling the lifecycle of a motion triggered transport.

| ID | Name                         | Type      | Constraint              | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|------------------------------|-----------|-------------------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | InitialDu<br>ration          | uint16    | min 1                   |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | Augmen<br>tation<br>Duration | uint16    | all                     |         |          |        | M               |
| 2  | MaxDura<br>tion              | elapsed-s | min Initial<br>Duration |         |          |        | M               |
| 3  | BlindDu<br>ration            | uint16    | all                     |         |          |        | M               |

When a Motion Trigger is activated, either by receiving a [ManuallyTriggerTransport](#page-942-1) command, or when motion is initially detected which matches a configured motion trigger, the Node SHALL start the push transport configured with this trigger see [\(TransportOptionsStruct\)](#page-929-0).

This places the Node in a Motion Detected state, at which point the Node SHALL internally track two values.

# **TimeSinceActivation**

The time in seconds since the trigger was activated.

# **MotionDetectedDuration**

Initially set to the InitialDuration value.

The transport SHALL remain active minimally for [InitialDuration](#page-929-1) period before a [PushTrans](#page-946-0)[portEnd](#page-946-0) event can occur.

However, if additional motion is detected during this MotionDetectedDuration period, the Node SHALL increase its value by the [AugmentationDuration](#page-929-2) value. This process may occur repeatedly, but after the first increase of MotionDetectedDuration, the Node SHALL NOT increase the Motion-DetectedDuration value unless the previous MotionDetectedDuration has been exceeded by the TimeSinceActivation.

If the TimeSinceActivation value exceeds the [MaxDuration](#page-929-3) or MotionDetectedDuration value, the Node SHALL generate a [PushTransportEnd](#page-946-0) event and stop detecting motion for this trigger for the period of the BlindDuration value.

If [SetTransportStatus](#page-940-0) is called anytime during this state and sets the [TransportStatus](#page-932-1) to Inactive, the Motion Detected state is superseded.

Since multiple triggers (and corresponding push transports) may be activated by the same motion, the Node SHALL perform this process independently for each motion trigger activated.

#### <span id="page-929-1"></span>**11.7.7.14.1. InitialDuration Field**

This field SHALL indicate the initial duration (in seconds) of the recording, following the initial trigger.

#### <span id="page-929-2"></span>**11.7.7.14.2. AugmentationDuration Field**

This field SHALL indicate the duration (in seconds) that the MotionDetectedDuration value is to be extended by if motion is still detected during this period.

#### <span id="page-929-3"></span>**11.7.7.14.3. MaxDuration Field**

This field SHALL indicate the maximum duration (in seconds) after initial motion detection that additional motion will be detected.

#### **11.7.7.14.4. BlindDuration Field**

This field SHALL indicate the duration (in seconds) after a transport finishes transmitting that the Node SHALL NOT activate the trigger again.

### <span id="page-930-2"></span>**11.7.7.15.1. StreamUsage Field**

This field contains the [StreamUsageEnum](#page-816-5) of this transport.

## <span id="page-930-0"></span>**11.7.7.15.2. VideoStreamID Field**

This field is deprecated and the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) field used instead.

If this field is encountered from clients implementing cluster revision 1, then the following SHALL be done:

- If not present, video isn't requested.
- If present and null, automatic video stream assignment is requested.
- If present and non-null, the specific video stream identified by the [VideoStreamID](#page-833-0) SHALL be added as an entry to the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) field using the [VideoStreamName](#page-922-0) of video.

#### <span id="page-930-1"></span>**11.7.7.15.3. AudioStreamID Field**

This field is deprecated and the [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) field used instead.

If this field is encountered from clients implementing cluster revision 1, then the following SHALL be done:

- If not present, audio isn't requested.
- If present and null, automatic audio stream assignment is requested.
- If present and non-null, the specific audio stream identified by the [AudioStreamID](#page-833-1) SHALL be added as an entry to the [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) field using the [AudioStreamName](#page-923-1) of audio.

#### <span id="page-931-5"></span>**11.7.7.15.4. TLSEndpointID Field**

This field SHALL be a TLSEndpointID representing a provisioned TLS Endpoint, which SHALL have valid TLSCAID and TLSCCDID values (see Chapter 14, Certificate Authority ID (CAID) Mapping and the ProvisionEndpoint command in the TLS Client Management Cluster sections in [\[MatterCore\]\)](#page-28-5).

#### <span id="page-931-0"></span>**11.7.7.15.5. URL Field**

This field SHALL be a valid string in [RFC 3986](#page-31-6) format representing the upload location. The field SHALL use the https scheme which will be validated by the underlying TLSEndpointID.

When the [IngestMethod](#page-931-3) is [CMAFIngest](#page-921-0), this SHALL be the CMAF [publishing\\_point\\_URL](https://dashif.org/Ingest/#publishing_point_url) [https://dashif.org/Ingest/#publishing\_point\_url] to transport the AV Stream to. The URL length does not need to include space for the full CMAF POST\_URL fields which specify the session, track, and segment names as these will be internally appended. See [Section 11.7.1.2, "Operation"](#page-905-2) for further restrictions on the characters allowed in the URL.

#### **11.7.7.15.6. TriggerOptions Field**

This field SHALL be of type [TransportTriggerOptionsStruct](#page-926-1) and represents the Trigger Type and its sub options.

#### <span id="page-931-3"></span>**11.7.7.15.7. IngestMethod Field**

This field SHALL be of type [IngestMethodsEnum](#page-920-0) and represents the Ingest Method to be used.

#### <span id="page-931-6"></span>**11.7.7.15.8. ContainerOptions Field**

This field SHALL be of type [ContainerOptionsStruct](#page-925-1) and represents the type of Push AV Stream Container to be uploaded and any additional options relating to the Container Format used.

#### <span id="page-931-7"></span>**11.7.7.15.9. ExpiryTime Field**

This field SHALL be an unsigned 32 bit integer representing the TTL in seconds of a transport allocation. If not present, the transport SHALL never expire.

#### <span id="page-931-1"></span>**11.7.7.15.10. VideoStreams Field**

This field SHALL be a list of [VideoStreamStruct](#page-922-5) which indicates the requested video streams and the stream names for this transport.

#### <span id="page-931-2"></span>**11.7.7.15.11. AudioStreams Field**

This field SHALL be a list of [AudioStreamStruct](#page-922-5) which indicates the requested audio streams and the stream names for this transport.

# <span id="page-931-4"></span>**11.7.7.16. TransportConfigurationStruct Type**

This encodes the current configuration of an allocated transport.

|    | Access Modifier: Fabric Scoped |                                   |            |         |          |        |                 |
|----|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| ID | Name                           | Type                              | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
| 0  | Connec<br>tionID               | PushTrans<br>portCon<br>nectionID | 0 to 65534 |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | Transport<br>Status            | Transport<br>Sta<br>tusEnum       | all        |         |          |        | M               |
| 2  | Trans<br>portOp<br>tions       | Trans<br>portOp<br>tionsStruct    |            |         |          |        | O               |

#### <span id="page-932-4"></span>**11.7.7.16.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) representing a unique transport.

#### <span id="page-932-1"></span>**11.7.7.16.2. TransportStatus Field**

This field SHALL represent the [Stream Transport Status](#page-920-6) of the transport.

#### <span id="page-932-3"></span>**11.7.7.16.3. TransportOptions Field**

This field SHALL represent the [Stream Transport Options](#page-929-0) of the transport.

#### <span id="page-932-2"></span>**11.7.7.17. PushTransportConnectionID Type**

This data type is derived from uint16.

It represents an allocated transport. This value starts at 0 and monotonically increases by 1 with each new allocation provisioned by the Node. A value incremented past 65534 SHALL wrap to 0. The Node SHALL verify that the incremented ID does not match any other ID. If such a match is found, the ID SHALL be incremented until a unique ID is found.

## <span id="page-934-1"></span>**11.7.9.1. SupportedFormats Attribute**

This attribute SHALL contain a list of [Supported Container Format](#page-921-1) structs, which represents the combinations of Ingestion Method and Container Format that the Node supports. Nodes SHALL support at least the combination [CMAFIngest](#page-921-0),[CMAF.](#page-920-1)

### <span id="page-934-2"></span>**11.7.9.2. CurrentConnections Attribute**

This attribute SHALL be a list of [TransportConfigurationStruct](#page-931-4) which represents all the allocated connections added via [AllocatePushTransport.](#page-935-0) When this attribute is read over a non Large Message (See Large Message Quality in the Data Model section of [\[MatterCore\]\)](#page-28-5) capable transport, the TransportOptions field SHALL NOT be included. To get the full details of the connections use the [FindTransport](#page-944-0) command. The maximum size of this list is run-time dependent upon the resource constraints of the system as described in [Resource Management and Stream Priorities](#page-818-2) and the currently used bandwidth of the total available specified by [MaxNetworkBandwidth](#page-839-6).

### <span id="page-935-0"></span>**11.7.10.1. AllocatePushTransport Command**

This command SHALL allocate a transport and return a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2).

| ID | Name        | Type       | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-------------|------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Trans       | Trans      |            |         |          | M               |
|    | portOptions | portOption |            |         |          |                 |
|    |             | sStruct    |            |         |          |                 |

### **11.7.10.1.1. TransportOptions Field**

This field SHALL represent the configuration options of the transport to be allocated.

#### **11.7.10.1.2. Effect on Receipt**

The following process SHALL be followed when the server receives this command:

- If the UTCTime attribute of the Time Synchronization cluster is null:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidTime, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If an entry for the [TLSEndpointID](#page-931-5) field, of the passed in *TransportOptions*, is not found in the ProvisionedEndpoints list attribute of the TLS Client Management Cluster:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidTLSEndpoint, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the associated fabric of that entry does not match the accessing fabric:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidTLSEndpoint, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If that entry does not contain a valid non-null CCDID:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidTLSEndpoint, and end pro-

cessing with no other side effects.

- If the requested combination of [IngestMethod](#page-931-3) and [ContainerType](#page-925-2) from the [ContainerOptions](#page-931-6) fields, of the passed in *TransportOptions*, is not in [SupportedFormats:](#page-934-1)
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidCombination, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the URL is invalid:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidURL, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the StreamUsage field's value is not present in the [StreamUsagePriorities](#page-839-0) list:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidStreamUsage, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the [MotionZones](#page-927-2) field is present in the TriggerOptions field of TransportOptions:
  - If there are any entries with duplicate values for the [Zone](#page-926-2) field in [MotionZones](#page-927-2):
    - Fail the command with the status code ALREADY\_EXISTS, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If the length of the [MotionZones](#page-927-2) list is greater than [MaxZones](#page-262-4):
    - Fail the command with the status code DYNAMIC\_CONSTRAINT\_ERROR, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If the [MotionZones](#page-927-2) list in the TriggerOptions field of TransportOptions contains an invalid [ZoneID](#page-261-1):
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidZone, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If this new transport would exceed the [bandwidth limits](#page-839-6):
  - Fail the command with RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) or [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) fields and either the [VideoStreamID](#page-930-0) or [AudioStreamID](#page-930-1) fields are present in the passed in *TransportOptions*:
  - Fail the command with INVALID\_COMMAND, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the [VideoStreamID](#page-930-0) field of the passed in *TransportOptions* is present:
  - If [AllocatedVideoStreams](#page-839-3) is empty:
    - Fail the command with the status code INVALID\_IN\_STATE, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If that field is null:
    - Automatically select an existing [video stream](#page-839-3) per the [Resource Management and Stream](#page-818-2) [Priorities](#page-818-2).
  - Add the provided or selected [VideoStreamID](#page-833-0) as a new entry in the passed in *TransportOptions* [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) list using the [VideoStreamName](#page-922-0) 'video'.
- If the [AudioStreamID](#page-930-1) field of the passed in *TransportOptions* is present:

- If [AllocatedAudioStreams](#page-839-2) is empty:
  - Fail the command with the status code INVALID\_IN\_STATE, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If that field is null:
  - Automatically select an existing [audio stream](#page-839-2) per the [Resource Management and Stream](#page-818-2) [Priorities.](#page-818-2)
- Add the provided or selected [AudioStreamID](#page-833-1) as a new entry in the passed in *TransportOptions* [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) list using the [AudioStreamName](#page-923-1) 'audio'.
- If both the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) and [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) fields of the passed in *TransportOptions* are not present or are empty:
  - Fail the command with the status code InvalidStream, and end processing with no other side effects.
- For each [VideoStreamStruct](#page-922-5) entry in the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) field of the passed in *TransportOptions*:
  - If any fields present are a duplicate of any other entry in the list:
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of DuplicateStreamValues, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If an entry for the [VideoStreamID](#page-922-6) field is not found in the [AllocatedVideoStreams](#page-839-3) list:
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidStream, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If the [ContainerOptions](#page-931-6) [ContainerType](#page-925-2) is [CMAF](#page-920-1) and the requested [SegmentDuration](#page-924-0) is not a multiple of the [KeyFrameInterval](#page-829-1) of that entry:
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidOptions, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If the [MaxPreRollLen](#page-927-3) field of the passed in *TransportOptions* is non-zero and is less than the [KeyFrameInterval](#page-829-1) value of that entry:
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidPreRollLength, and end processing with no other side effects.
- For each [AudioStreamStruct](#page-923-2) entry in the [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) field of the passed in *TransportOptions*:
  - If any fields present are a duplicate of any other entry in the list:
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of DuplicateStreamValues, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If the [AudioStreamName](#page-923-1) field is a duplicate of any [VideoStreamName](#page-922-0) entry in the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) list of the passed in *TransportOptions*:
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of DuplicateStreamValues, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If an entry for the [AudioStreamID](#page-923-3) field is not found in the [AllocatedAudioStreams](#page-839-2) list:
    - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidStream, and end processing with no other side effects.
- Create a new [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2)

- Using the [TLSEndpointID](#page-931-5) field of the passed in *TransportOptions*, increment the ReferenceCount field of the matching EndpointID entry in the TLS Client Management Cluster's ProvisionedEndpoints list.
- Allocate a new [TransportConfigurationStruct](#page-931-4) associated with the accessing fabric and set the ConnectionID and [TransportOptions](#page-932-3) fields of that struct to the new values.
- Set the [TransportStatus](#page-932-1) field of the new [TransportConfigurationStruct](#page-931-4) to Inactive.
- Persistently store the resulting [TransportConfigurationStruct](#page-931-4).
- Update the contents of the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) list attribute to include the new entry.
- If the [TransportOptions](#page-932-3) field has a non null [ExpiryTime](#page-931-7) field:
  - Keep track of the time in seconds since allocation for this transport, and once this exceeds the [ExpiryTime](#page-931-7) the Node SHALL stop any transport for this transport and deallocate it.
- Return the resulting [TransportConfigurationStruct](#page-931-4) of this allocation in the corresponding [Allo](#page-938-0)[catePushTransportResponse](#page-938-0) command.

On reboot the Node SHALL restart any transports which were transporting previously.

### <span id="page-938-0"></span>**11.7.10.2. AllocatePushTransportResponse Command**

This command SHALL be generated in response to a successful [AllocatePushTransport](#page-935-0) command.

| ID | Name      | Type       | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-----------|------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Transport | Transport  |            |         |          | M               |
|    | Configura | Configura  |            |         |          |                 |
|    | tion      | tionStruct |            |         |          |                 |

### **11.7.10.2.1. TransportConfiguration Field**

This field SHALL be a [TransportConfigurationStruct](#page-931-4) representing the newly allocated transport.

For compatibility with clients implementing cluster revision 1, the VideoStreamID and AudioStreamID fields SHALL be populated with the first video and audio stream entries that exist in the [VideoStreams](#page-931-1) and [AudioStreams](#page-931-2) lists.

#### **11.7.10.3. DeallocatePushTransport Command**

This command SHALL be generated to request the Node deallocates the specified transport.

| ID | Name   | Type                 | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|--------|----------------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Connec | PushTrans            | 0 to 65534 |         |          | M               |
|    | tionID | portConnec<br>tionID |            |         |          |                 |

#### **11.7.10.3.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) representing the allocated transport to deallocate.

#### **11.7.10.3.2. Effect on Receipt**

The following process SHALL be followed when the server receives this command:

- If no entry can be found for the passed in *ConnectionID* in the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) list attribute:
  - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the associated fabric of that entry is not the accessing fabric:
  - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the transport is currently uploading:
  - Fail the command with the status code BUSY, and end processing with no other side effects.
- Remove that entry from the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) list attribute.
- Using the [TLSEndpointID](#page-931-5) field of that entry, decrement the ReferenceCount field of the matching EndpointID entry in the TLS Client Management Cluster's ProvisionedEndpoints list.
- Deallocate the transport using the passed in *ConnectionID*.

# <span id="page-939-0"></span>**11.7.10.4. ModifyPushTransport Command**

This command is used to request the Node modifies the configuration of the specified push transport.

| ID | Name                 | Type                              | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|----------------------|-----------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Connec<br>tionID     | PushTrans<br>portConnec<br>tionID | 0 to 65534 |         |          | M               |
| 1  | Trans<br>portOptions | Trans<br>portOption<br>sStruct    |            |         |          | M               |

#### **11.7.10.4.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) representing the transport to modify.

#### **11.7.10.4.2. TransportOptions Field**

This field SHALL represent the [Transport Options](#page-929-0) to modify.

#### **11.7.10.4.3. Effect on Receipt**

The following process SHALL be followed when the server receives this command:

- If the UTCTime attribute of the Time Synchronization cluster is null:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidTime, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If no entry can be found for the passed in *ConnectionID* in the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) list attribute:
  - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the associated fabric of that entry is not the accessing fabric:
  - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the transport is currently uploading:
  - Fail the command with the status code BUSY, and end processing with no other side effects.
- On that entry, update the [TransportOptions](#page-932-3) field, of the [TransportConfiguration](#page-931-4) field, to the passed in *TransportOptions*.

# <span id="page-940-0"></span>**11.7.10.5. SetTransportStatus Command**

This command SHALL be generated to request the Node modifies the Transport Status of a specified transport or all transports.

| ID | Name                | Type                              | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------------------|-----------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Connec<br>tionID    | PushTrans<br>portConnec<br>tionID | all        | X       |          | M               |
| 1  | Transport<br>Status | Transport<br>StatusEnum           | all        |         |          | M               |

### **11.7.10.5.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) representing the transport to modify. If null is passed, all transports belonging to the calling fabric will be modified.

#### **11.7.10.5.2. TransportStatus Field**

This field SHALL be a [TransportStatusEnum](#page-920-6) and represent the new transport status to apply.

#### **11.7.10.5.3. Effect on Receipt**

The following process SHALL be followed when the server receives this command:

• If the passed in *TransportStatus* is set to Active, and the UTCTime attribute of the Time Synchronization cluster is null:

- Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidTime, and end processing with no other side effects.
- Create a temporary list
- If the passed in *ConnectionID* field is null:
  - For each entry in [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2):
    - If the associated fabric of that entry is the accessing fabric:
      - Add the [ConnectionID](#page-932-4) of that entry to the temporary list.
- Else:
  - If no entry can be found for the passed in *ConnectionID* in the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) list:
    - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - If the associated fabric of that entry is not the accessing fabric:
    - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side effects.
  - Add *ConnectionID* to the temporary list
- For each [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) in the temporary list:
  - If the passed in *TransportStatus* field is set to Inactive:
    - Disable transmissions on the transport identified by the id.
    - Remove any queued items for upload on the transport.
    - Terminate any media content uploads currently in progress by using the HTTP/2 stream cancel process, as defined in Section 6.4 of [RFC 9113.](#page-30-16)
    - Perform any Container specific session closing uploads.
    - Generate a [PushTransportEnd](#page-946-0) event.
  - Else if the passed in *TransportStatus* field is set to Active:
    - Enable transmissions on the transport identified by the id.
    - If all [Privacy Related attributes](#page-820-0) are False:
      - If the transport's trigger type is [Continuous:](#page-920-3)
        - Begin transmission immediately.
        - Generate a [PushTransportBegin](#page-945-1) event.
      - Else if the transport's trigger type is [Command](#page-920-5) or [Motion,](#page-920-4) and the underlying trigger is currently active and still within the [Time Control Bounds](#page-928-0):
        - Begin transmission immediately.
        - Generate a [PushTransportBegin](#page-945-1) event.
  - Set [TransportStatus](#page-920-6) of the transport identified by the id to the value in the TransportStatus field of this command.

## <span id="page-942-1"></span>**11.7.10.6. ManuallyTriggerTransport Command**

This command SHALL be generated to request the Node to manually start the specified push transport.

| ID | Name                 | Type                                                | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Connec<br>tionID     | PushTrans<br>portConnec<br>tionID                   | 0 to 65534 |         |          | M               |
| 1  | Activation<br>Reason | TriggerActi<br>vationReaso<br>nEnum                 | all        |         |          | M               |
| 2  | TimeCon<br>trol      | Transport<br>MotionTrig<br>gerTimeCon<br>trolStruct |            |         |          | O               |
| 3  | UserDefined octstr   |                                                     | max 256    |         |          | [METADATA]      |

#### **11.7.10.6.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) representing the push transport to start or stop.

### **11.7.10.6.2. ActivationReason Field**

This field SHALL provide information as to why the transport was started or stopped.

#### **11.7.10.6.3. TimeControl Field**

This field SHALL be a struct of type [TransportMotionTriggerTimeControlStruct](#page-928-0), but the BlindDuration field SHALL be ignored.

#### <span id="page-942-0"></span>**11.7.10.6.4. UserDefined Field**

This field SHALL be an octet string representing arbitrary format user defined metadata that will be included in the recording via the [UserDefined](#page-833-3) field of [AVMetadataStruct.](#page-832-0) The format and meaning of this field is not defined in this specification and is up to the users, vendors, or ecosystems deploying it.

#### **11.7.10.6.5. Effect on Receipt**

The following process SHALL be followed when the server receives this command:

- If the UTCTime attribute of the Time Synchronization cluster is null:
  - Fail the command with the cluster-specific status code of InvalidTime, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If no mapping can be found for the ConnectionID:
  - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side

effects.

- If the associated fabric of the entry in the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) attribute which is identified by ConnectionID is not the accessing fabric:
  - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If [HardPrivacyModeOn](#page-840-3) is true:
  - Fail the command with the status code INVALID\_IN\_STATE, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If [SoftLivestreamPrivacyModeEnabled](#page-840-1) is true and [StreamUsage Field](#page-930-2) for the ConnectionID is [LiveView](#page-817-3):
  - Fail the command with the status code INVALID\_IN\_STATE, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If [SoftRecordingPrivacyModeEnabled](#page-840-0) is true and [StreamUsage Field](#page-930-2) for the ConnectionID is [Recording](#page-817-1) or [Analysis:](#page-817-2)
  - Fail the command with the status code INVALID\_IN\_STATE, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the transport is already transmitting:
  - Fail the command with the status code BUSY, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the [TransportStatus](#page-931-4) of the push transport is Inactive:
  - Fail the command with a cluster-specific status code of InvalidTransportStatus, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the trigger type for the specified transport is [Continuous:](#page-920-3)
  - Fail the command with a cluster-specific status code of InvalidTriggerType, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the trigger type for the specified transport is [Command](#page-920-5) and the TimeControl field is not present:
  - Fail the command with the status code DYNAMIC\_CONSTRAINT\_ERROR, and end processing with no other side effects.
- If the TimeControl field is not present:
  - Look up the [MotionTimeControl](#page-927-4) field in the in the allocated ConnectionID and use those values as the TimeControl.
- Begin transmission using the TimeControl values, but ignore the BlindDuration field.
- Generate a [PushTransportBegin](#page-945-1) event with ConnectionID set to the ConnectionID field of this command, the ActivationReason field set to the ActivationReason field of this command and the TriggerType field set to [Command](#page-920-5).
- Asynchronously generate the [PushTransportEnd](#page-946-0) event as normal when the TimeControl values indicate this transmission will end.

### <span id="page-944-0"></span>**11.7.10.7. FindTransport Command**

This command SHALL return the [Transport Configuration](#page-931-4) for the specified push transport or all allocated transports for the fabric if null.

| ID | Name             | Type                    | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|------------------|-------------------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Connec<br>tionID | PushTrans<br>portConnec | all        | X       |          | M               |
|    |                  | tionID                  |            |         |          |                 |

#### **11.7.10.7.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) or NULL representing the allocated push transport.

#### **11.7.10.7.2. Effect on Receipt**

The following process SHALL be followed when the server receives this command:

- If ConnectionID is null:
  - If the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) list is empty:
    - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND.
  - For each entry in [CurrentConnections:](#page-934-2)
    - If the associated fabric of the entry matches the accessing fabric:
      - Add the full [TransportConfigurationStruct](#page-931-4) to the resulting list.
- Else if ConnectionID is not null:
  - If an entry matching ConnectionID is not found in the [CurrentConnections](#page-934-2) list:
    - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND.
  - If the associated fabric of the matching list entry does not match the accessing fabric:
    - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND.
  - Add a single entry to the resulting list containing the full [Transport Configuration](#page-931-4) that matches ConnectionID.
- If the resulting list is empty:
  - Fail the command with the status code NOT\_FOUND.
- Return the resulting list in the corresponding [FindTransportResponse](#page-944-1) command.

# <span id="page-944-1"></span>**11.7.10.8. FindTransportResponse Command**

This command SHALL be generated in response to a successful [FindTransport](#page-944-0) command.

| ID | Name      | Type          | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|-----------|---------------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | Transport | list[Trans    |            |         |          | M               |
|    | Configura | portConfigu   |            |         |          |                 |
|    | tions     | rationStruct] |            |         |          |                 |

#### **11.7.10.8.1. TransportConfigurations Field**

This field SHALL be a list of [Transport Configurations](#page-931-4).

# <span id="page-945-0"></span>**11.7.11. Events**

| ID   | Name                   | Priority | Quality | Access | Conformance |
|------|------------------------|----------|---------|--------|-------------|
| 0x00 | PushTrans<br>portBegin | INFO     |         | V      | M           |
| 0x01 | PushTrans<br>portEnd   | INFO     |         | V      | M           |

# <span id="page-945-1"></span>**11.7.11.1. PushTransportBegin Event**

This event SHALL indicate a push transport transmission has begun.

With [Motion](#page-920-4) and [Continuous](#page-920-3) based triggers, this event SHALL be generated when each new recording starts uploading.

With [Command](#page-920-5) based triggers, this event SHALL be generated when uploading starts via the [Manu](#page-942-1)[allyTriggerTransport](#page-942-1) command.

| ID | Name                 | Type                                | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance           |
|----|----------------------|-------------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|---------------------------|
| 0  | Connec<br>tionID     | PushTrans<br>portConnec<br>tionID   | 0 to 65534 |         |          | M                         |
| 1  | TriggerType          | Transport<br>TriggerType<br>Enum    | all        |         |          | M                         |
| 2  | Activation<br>Reason | TriggerActi<br>vationReaso<br>nEnum | all        |         |          | TriggerType<br>== Command |
| 3  | Container<br>Type    | Container<br>FormatEnum             | all        |         |          | Rev >= v2                 |

| ID | Name                  | Type   | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance              |
|----|-----------------------|--------|------------|---------|----------|------------------------------|
| 4  | CMAFSes<br>sionNumber | uint64 | all        |         |          | Container<br>Type ==<br>CMAF |

#### **11.7.11.1.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) representing the push transport which started transmitting.

#### **11.7.11.1.2. TriggerType Field**

This field SHALL represent the type of trigger which caused this event to be generated.

#### **11.7.11.1.3. ActivationReason Field**

This field SHALL only be present when the TriggerType is Command and provides the reason for the event.

#### **11.7.11.1.4. ContainerType Field**

This field SHALL indicate the container type chosen for this transport.

#### **11.7.11.1.5. CMAFSessionNumber Field**

This field SHALL represent the [CMAF Session number](#page-906-3) of the recording session that was triggered.

### <span id="page-946-0"></span>**11.7.11.2. PushTransportEnd Event**

This event SHALL indicate a push transport upload of the indicated recording has completed.

With [Motion,](#page-920-4) [Continuous,](#page-920-3) and [Command](#page-920-5) based triggers, this event SHALL be generated when each new recording finishes uploading.

| ID | Name                  | Type                              | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance              |
|----|-----------------------|-----------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|------------------------------|
| 0  | Connec<br>tionID      | PushTrans<br>portConnec<br>tionID | 0 to 65534 |         |          | M                            |
| 1  | Container<br>Type     | Container<br>FormatEnum           | all        |         |          | Rev >= v2                    |
| 2  | CMAFSes<br>sionNumber | uint64                            | all        |         |          | Container<br>Type ==<br>CMAF |

#### **11.7.11.2.1. ConnectionID Field**

This field SHALL be a [PushTransportConnectionID](#page-932-2) representing the push transport which stopped transmitting.

#### **11.7.11.2.2. ContainerType field**

This field SHALL indicate the container type chosen for this transport.

### **11.7.11.2.3. CMAFSessionNumber Field**

This field SHALL represent the [CMAF Session number](#page-906-3) of the recording session that ended.

# <span id="page-947-0"></span>**11.8. Chime Cluster**

This cluster provides facilities to configure and play Chime sounds, such as those used in a doorbell.

# <span id="page-947-1"></span>**11.8.1. Revision History**

The global ClusterRevision attribute value SHALL be the highest revision number in the table below.

| Revision | Description                                                                                                                                            |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1        | Initial release                                                                                                                                        |
| 2        | Add ChimeStartedPlaying event, new optional<br>param to PlayChimeSound to play a specific<br>sound, and remove F quality from Installed<br>ChimeSounds |

# <span id="page-947-2"></span>**11.8.2. Classification**

| Hierarchy | Role        | Scope    | PICS Code |
|-----------|-------------|----------|-----------|
| Base      | Application | Endpoint | CHIME     |

# <span id="page-947-3"></span>**11.8.3. Cluster ID**

| ID     | Name  |
|--------|-------|
| 0x0556 | Chime |

# <span id="page-947-4"></span>**11.8.4. Data Types**

#### <span id="page-947-5"></span>**11.8.4.1. ChimeSoundStruct Type**

This struct is used to encode information needed to define a Chime Sound.

| ID | Name    | Type   | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------|--------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0  | ChimeID | uint8  | all        |         |          |        | M               |
| 1  | Name    | string | 1 to 48    |         |          |        | M               |

# <span id="page-948-1"></span>**11.8.4.1.1. ChimeID Field**

This field SHALL represent the unique ID for a Chime sound.

#### <span id="page-948-2"></span>**11.8.4.1.2. Name Field**

This field SHALL represent the unique user friendly name of the Chime Sound.

# <span id="page-948-0"></span>**11.8.5. Attributes**

| ID     | Name                         | Type                           | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Access | Confor<br>mance |
|--------|------------------------------|--------------------------------|------------|---------|----------|--------|-----------------|
| 0x0000 | Installed<br>Chime<br>Sounds | list[Chime<br>Sound<br>Struct] | 1 to 255   |         |          | R V    | M               |
| 0x0001 | Selected<br>Chime            | uint8                          | all        | N       |          | RW VO  | M               |
| 0x0002 | Enabled                      | bool                           | all        | N       |          | RW VO  | M               |

# <span id="page-948-3"></span>**11.8.5.1. InstalledChimeSounds Attribute**

This attribute SHALL contain all installed chime sounds, represented by a list of [Chime Sounds](#page-947-5). Each entry in this list SHALL have a unique [ChimeID](#page-948-1) value and a unique [Name](#page-948-2) value.

# <span id="page-948-4"></span>**11.8.5.2. SelectedChime Attribute**

This attribute SHALL indicate the currently selected chime sound that will be played when [Play-](#page-949-2)[ChimeSound](#page-949-2) is invoked and SHALL be the [ChimeID](#page-948-1) value for the requested Chime Sound within [InstalledChimeSounds.](#page-948-3)

This attribute MAY be written by the client to request a different chime sound. An attempt to write a value that is not contained within [InstalledChimeSounds](#page-948-3) SHALL be failed with a NOT\_FOUND response. Writes to this attribute while a chime is currently playing SHALL NOT affect the playback in progress and SHALL only apply starting at the next PlayChimeSound command invocation.

# <span id="page-948-5"></span>**11.8.5.3. Enabled Attribute**

This attribute SHALL indicate if chime sounds can currently be played or not, and MAY be written by the client to enable / disable playing of chime sounds.

# <span id="page-949-0"></span>**11.8.6. Commands**

| ID   | Name               | Direction          | Response | Access | Quality | Confor<br>mance |
|------|--------------------|--------------------|----------|--------|---------|-----------------|
| 0x00 | PlayChime<br>Sound | client ⇒<br>server | N        | O      |         | M               |

# <span id="page-949-2"></span>**11.8.6.1. PlayChimeSound Command**

This command will play the currently selected chime or the chime passed in. In either case the server SHALL generate the [ChimeStartedPlaying](#page-950-0) event.

| ID | Name    | Type  | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------|-------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | ChimeID | uint8 | all        |         |          | P, [Rev >= v2]  |

#### **11.8.6.1.1. ChimeID Field**

This field SHALL represent the unique ID for a Chime sound to play if present, instead of the current value in [SelectedChime](#page-948-4).

#### **11.8.6.1.2. Effect on Receipt**

The following process SHALL be followed when the server receives this command:

- If [Enabled](#page-948-5) is currently false:
  - The server SHALL immediately respond with a status code of SUCCESS, and end processing with no other side-effects.
- If a chime sound is currently being played:
  - The server SHALL immediately respond with a status code of SUCCESS, and end processing with no other side-effects.
- If the passed in *ChimeID* is present:
  - If an entry for the passed in *ChimeID* does not exist in the [InstalledChimeSounds](#page-948-3) list:
    - The server SHALL immediately respond with a status code of NOT\_FOUND, and end processing with no other side-effects.
  - Start playing the chime sound associated with *ChimeID*.
- Else
  - Start playing the chime sound associated with [SelectedChime](#page-948-4).
- Generate the [ChimeStartedPlaying](#page-950-0) event.

# <span id="page-949-1"></span>**11.8.7. Events**

| ID   | Name                    | Priority | Quality | Access | Conformance  |
|------|-------------------------|----------|---------|--------|--------------|
| 0x00 | ChimeStarted<br>Playing | INFO     |         | V      | P, Rev >= v2 |

# <span id="page-950-0"></span>**11.8.7.1. ChimeStartedPlaying Event**

This event SHALL indicate a Chime sound has just started playing.

The data on this event SHALL contain the following information.

| ID | Name    | Type  | Constraint | Quality | Fallback | Confor<br>mance |
|----|---------|-------|------------|---------|----------|-----------------|
| 0  | ChimeID | uint8 | all        |         |          | M               |

#### **11.8.7.1.1. ChimeID Field**

This field SHALL represent the unique ID for the Chime sound that just started playing.
